name: capcut_add_viral_caption
description: Injects Aeovisuals-calibrated viral typography with -1.0 metric kerning, 26/26 diffuse ambient shadow, custom font, power word scaling/color contrast, and optional Quad Ease hover-up pop keyframes.

accent_color.description: Hex accent color for power words (default #FF1E27 Crimson, or #FFD700 Gold).

enable_hover_pop.description: If true, automatically keyframes a 5-frame snappy hover-up pop from floor to baseline with opacity fade.

font_family.description: Font superfamily (Montserrat/Poppins recommended for viral videos).

power_words.description: Specific keywords to emphasize with 1.4x scale and power accent color (e.g. ["10 MILLION", "MONEY"]).
